_comment: The desks this page can manage. Adding one is an edit here, not a code change: a label, its realm path, and the network it lives on. `default` is the desk shown when no ?realm is in the URL and nothing is remembered; change that one line to move the default. The network a desk names is the one the page switches to when you pick it; you can still change network by hand afterwards.

desks.label: Small grants (demo)
desks.blurb: A public desk for small GNOT grants on a testnet: see every request and what was decided, and file one yourself.
